tooltip.cobblemonranger.styler_hint: Use on a wild Pokémon to capture. Sneak-use to release partners.
tooltip.cobblemonranger.module_hint: Apply to a styler at a smithing table
screen.cobblemonranger.hint: Hold left click and draw loops around the Pokémon. Don't let it touch the line! Esc to give up.
message.cobblemonranger.not_wild: Only wild Pokémon can be captured with a styler.
message.cobblemonranger.in_battle: That Pokémon is in a battle.
message.cobblemonranger.busy: A capture is already in progress.
message.cobblemonranger.no_energy: Your styler is out of energy. It recharges over time, or repair it with redstone at an anvil.
message.cobblemonranger.party_full: Your party is full, so there's no room for a partner Pokémon.
message.cobblemonranger.capture_failed_e: Your styler ran out of energy and the Pokémon got away!
message.cobblemonranger.capture_escaped: %s got away before the capture finished.
message.cobblemonranger.captured: Capture complete! %s will help you as a partner Pokémon until your next battle is over.
message.cobblemonranger.release_in_battl: You can't release partners during a battle.
message.cobblemonranger.battle_over: Thanks for the help! %s is heading home.
message.cobblemonranger.partner_hint: %s is your partner. Sneak and use the styler on it to release it.
